core.injector.injector.Injector.loadCont.summary: Loads a controller, checks its dependencies, and applies enhancers based on context.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadCtor.summary: Loads constructor metadata, resolves scoped components, and fetches instances by context ID.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadEnha.summary: Loads an instance with dependencies from a host module's injectables.
Loads and initializes enhancers by mapping each to its instance and resolution context.
Loads enhancers for a context, skipping static contexts.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadInje.summary: Loads an injectable instance from a module, handling context and dependencies.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadInst.summary: Loads an instance, checks for circular dependencies, resolves properties, and handles errors.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadMidd.summary: Checks if an instance exists; if not, creates and loads it.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadPerC.summary: Loads an instance per context by checking or creating a wrapper, then resolves, enhances, waits, and returns the instance.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadProp.summary: This function processes property metadata to resolve and return dependency instances.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadProt.summary: Loads a prototype instance from a collection, sets it by context, or returns nothing if collection is empty.

core.injector.injector.Injector.loadProv.summary: Loads a provider, checks dependencies, and manages enhancers based on context.

core.injector.injector.Injector.lookup.summary: Looks up a dependency, resolves it if found, throws error if not optional.

core.injector.injector.Injector.lookupCo.summary: Looks up a component by token, throwing an error if not found, or adds metadata if found.
Looks up a component in imported modules, tracking visited modules and adding dependency metadata.
Looks up a component in parent modules, throws exception if not found.

core.injector.injector.Injector.lookupSk.summary: Looks up dependencies for request-scoped or transient providers, throwing on first failure.

core.injector.injector.Injector.mapFacto.summary: Maps an injection token or factory dependency to a token, handling optional dependencies and undefined cases.

core.injector.injector.Injector.printFou.summary: Logs a debug message if debug mode is on, showing the token name and module reference.

core.injector.injector.Injector.printLoo.summary: Logs a debug message if debug mode is on, searching for a provider in a module.

core.injector.injector.Injector.printRes.summary: Logs dependency resolution if debug mode is on, showing token and inquirer names.

core.injector.injector.Injector.reflectC.summary: Reflects constructor parameters, merges with self parameters, and returns as array.

core.injector.injector.Injector.reflectO.summary: Retrieves optional dependencies for a given type using metadata reflection.

core.injector.injector.Injector.reflectP.summary: Reflects and maps property dependencies with optional flags for a given type.

core.injector.injector.Injector.reflectS.summary: Retrieves metadata for dependencies declared by a class or function, returning an empty array if none found.

core.injector.injector.Injector.resolveC.summary: Resolves component host by loading provider or handling forward refs, updating context and signals.
Logs dependency resolution, searches for provider, and resolves component.
Resolves constructor parameters by loading metadata, resolving dependencies, and invoking a callback with resolved instances.

core.injector.injector.Injector.resolveP.summary: Resolves a parameter by signaling barriers, checking context, and returning an instance or undefined on error.
Checks if param has forwardRef, sets wrapper forwardRef true, returns forwardRef result if so, else returns param.
Resolves properties for a wrapper, using metadata, context, and optional dependencies, returning resolved instances or undefined.

core.injector.injector.Injector.resolveS.summary: Resolves scoped component host by checking inquirer request and resolving component host if needed.
Resolves a single parameter by logging undefined errors or finding and returning the component wrapper.

core.injector.injector.Injector.shouldSk.summary: Determines if provider loading should be skipped based on context and provider scope.

core.injector.injector.Injector.trackDur.summary: Tracks deferred loads in a durable context, updating shared dependents and handling failures.

core.injector.injector.Injector.untrack.summary: This function iterates over a list and calls each item as a function to untrack something.

core.injector.injector.Injector.waitForD.summary: Waits for deferred loads, removes them if successful, or throws if one fails.

core.injector.inquirer.inquirer-provider.summary: This function does nothing; it has an empty body with no checks, computations, changes, sends, raises, or returns.

core.injector.instance-links-host.Instan.summary: Adds a link to an instance map, creating or updating the entry for a given token.
Initializes the instance links host when the container is set.
Retrieves instance links for a token, optionally filtering by module ID, and throws an exception if not found.
Returns the name of the token if it's a function; otherwise, returns the token as a string.
Initializes instance links by iterating through modules and their providers, injectables, and controllers.

core.injector.instance-loader.InstanceLo.summary: This function initializes an instance loader with dependencies for NestJS application management.
This function initializes modules by creating instances of providers, injectables, and controllers, checks if modules are whitelisted, and logs module initialization.
This function creates instances of controllers from a module by loading and inspecting them.
Creates instances of dependencies, inspects modules, handles errors, and registers partials.
This function creates instances of injectables by loading and inspecting them.
This function creates instances of providers by loading them, inspecting them, and discovering their meta-hosts.
This function iterates over modules and creates prototypes for providers, injectables, and controllers.
This function iterates over controllers and loads their prototypes using an injector.
This function iterates over module injectables and loads their prototypes using the injector.
This function iterates over module providers and loads prototypes using the injector.
Checks if a module name is not the internal core module name and returns the result.
Sets the logger for the instance loader, storing it as an instance variable.

core.injector.instance-wrapper.InstanceW.summary: Returns the hierarchy level of the instance wrapper.
Sets the hierarchy level to the given number.
